cards.name: Tend the Pests
cards.oracleText:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice a creature.
Create X 1/1 black and green Pest creature tokens with "When this token dies, you gain 1 life," where X is the sacrificed creature's power.

cards.name: Tendershoot Dryad

At the beginning of each upkeep, create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
Saprolings you control get +2/+2 as long as you have the city's blessing.

Tend to the Kiln
cards.oracleText:
When this enchantment enters, all non-Elemental instant and sorcery cards you own perpetually become Elemental kindreds in addition to their other types.
